title: Profile
subtitle: Your details, preferences, and privacy in one place.

future.statusDescription: In the future, you can share a mood or plan for 1–4 hours and, only after choosing to continue, see nearby people with a similar intention.

care.activeDescription: All reminders and AI suggestions are enabled

giftLearning.title: Learn from gift reactions
giftLearning.description: Use only your confirmed feedback to improve future gift ideas.

reminderSettings.title: Reminder settings
reminderSettings.description: Choose when Happy may contact you and how often an unfinished reminder repeats.
reminderSettings.carePromiseTitle: You set the boundaries of care.
reminderSettings.carePromiseBody: Happy respects quiet hours and repeats important reminders only at the pace you choose.
reminderSettings.timingDescription: Set your time zone, quiet hours, and repetition rhythm.
reminderSettings.deliveryDescription: Choose in-app messages and, on a supported phone, system push notifications.
reminderSettings.channelRequired: At least one channel must stay active so an important reminder cannot disappear.
reminderSettings.pushPermission: After saving, HappyDate will request system notification permission.
reminderSettings.pushNativeOnly: Push notifications can be enabled in the HappyDate mobile app.

knowledgeReviewSettings.title: Review saved information
knowledgeReviewSettings.description: Let Happy occasionally ask whether facts about important people are still accurate.

exportSettings.title: Export my data
exportSettings.description: Download a JSON copy of the information you saved in HappyDate.
exportSettings.ownershipDescription: HappyDate prepares a copy of your information only and downloads it directly to this device.
exportSettings.formatDescription: The JSON file can be stored, read by software, or moved to another service.
exportSettings.included: Profile, people, events, notes and memory, gifts and links, reminders, settings, change history, and technical Knowledge review events.
exportSettings.sensitiveNote: This file may contain private information. Store it securely. Push notification tokens are never exported.
exportSettings.done: Your file was prepared and downloaded.
exportSettings.error: The export could not be prepared. Please try again.

sessionSettings.title: Active sessions
sessionSettings.description: Manage access to HappyDate on other devices without interrupting this one.
sessionSettings.currentDescription: You are currently using this protected HappyDate session.
sessionSettings.othersDescription: If you signed in on a shared or lost device, end every other session in one safe step.
sessionSettings.done: Other sessions have ended. This device remains active.
sessionSettings.error: Sessions could not be checked or ended. Please try again.
sessionSettings.tokenNote: Other devices will no longer be able to refresh their sessions. An already issued short-lived token may continue until it expires.

deleteAccountSettings.title: Delete account
deleteAccountSettings.description: This decision is final. HappyDate first helps you make sure it is truly what you want.
deleteAccountSettings.pauseTitle: Take your memories with you first
deleteAccountSettings.pauseDescription: You can download a copy of everything you saved before deletion. It cannot be restored afterwards.
deleteAccountSettings.permanentDescription: We will delete the account and its entire private HappyDate space.

items.files: Avatar, private photos, and voice recordings
items.account: Reminders, settings, sessions, and the account itself

deleteAccountSettings.understand: I understand that deletion is permanent and the data cannot be restored.
deleteAccountSettings.confirmLabel: To confirm, enter the account email: {email}
deleteAccountSettings.reauthDescription: A decision this important requires a recent sign-in. Sign in again, then confirm deletion once more.
deleteAccountSettings.error: Deletion could not be completed. Do not retry repeatedly—check your connection or contact support.

errors.saveFailed: Changes could not be saved. Please try again.
errors.avatarSaveFailed: The photo was uploaded, but the profile could not be updated.
errors.uploadFailed: The photo could not be uploaded. Please try again.
errors.giftLearningSaveFailed: Could not save the gift learning preference.
